## 1. Batch import of prompt sounds
1. Click here "[upaudios.tar.gz](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=0b0a970520fe71f343285e01167b1961 "[upaudios.tar.gz")" Download the compressed package locally, double-click twice to open the compressed package, and you can see that there are many audio files inside.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=c74a96dfebce27b3b26794c1398d2625)
1. Delete unnecessary audio files and copy and drag in the audio files that need to be imported, close the compressed package, save and re-compress. At this time, the upgrade compressed package is completed.
For audio file acquisition and definition instructions, please refer to [Instructions for customizing prompt sounds](http://pug2.4000329988.com/web/#/11/85 "Instructions for customizing prompt sounds")
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=5dfec38f8ea78cf302577d741e595bf8)

1. Import the device
3.1 Remote import
Log in to the platform client and use the online upgrade function to upgrade this compressed package. For the upgrade method, please refer to Device Upgrade - Q&A
`Note: The file name must end with "audios.tar.gz". It is best not to change the file name to keep it consistent when downloading, as shown in the figure: `
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=7873f82fb2cf17e0ec3628d106952201)
3.2 Local import
Take out the SD card or hard disk used in the device and insert it into the computer. Open the root directory of the first partition and copy this compressed package and put it in, as shown in the figure:
`Note: The file name must be "audios.tar.gz", and the downloaded compressed package needs to be renamed by removing the "up" letter. `
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=397dd464f95154c2daa472a0a251944c)
1. Restart the device. The import will be completed quickly after the device is turned on again.

## 2. Batch deletion of prompt sounds
1. Click here "[delaudios.tar.gz](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=9890b390df364e1c4afb3a5402e5a3ff "[delaudios.tar.gz")" Download the compressed package locally, double-click twice to open the compressed package, and you can see the VoiceFilesDiff.xml file.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=79e7b3071b84e654060ea28a0b163e5b)
1. Open this file and fill in the complete name of the audio file that needs to be deleted, as shown below. After saving, close the file and recompress it. At this time, the deletion package is completed.
`Note: The file name must end with "audios.tar.gz". It is best not to change the file name to keep it consistent when downloading. `
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=cb67c81d1b94fa2298d524d1155702b3)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=81177a27ba14e9813cb2b050316862b8)
1. After saving, delete the compressed package and perform remote upgrade on the platform before restarting the device.
3.1 Remote import
Log in to the platform client and use the online upgrade function to upgrade this compressed package. For the upgrade method, please refer to Device Upgrade - Q&A
`Note: The file name must end with "audios.tar.gz". It is best not to change the file name to keep it consistent when downloading, as shown in the figure: `
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=c3359e7f3c24e21d2878bfd30caa0f0f)
3.2 Local import
Take out the SD card or hard disk used in the device and insert it into the computer. Open the root directory of the first partition and copy this compressed package and put it in, as shown in the figure:
`Note: The file name must be "audios.tar.gz", and the downloaded compressed package needs to be renamed by removing the "del" letter. `
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=e92a1dc7d4ae2a08a485e7ed94189388)
1. Restart the device. The audio files filled in the document will be quickly deleted after the device is turned on again.

## 3. Prompt tone batch query
1. Log in to the platform client, select the online device and click parameter configuration. For the client parameter configuration method, please refer to the TTX client plug-in tool - Q&A
1. Send the following query command, and the output window will return the name of the audio file that exists on the device.
```xml
<Control><CmdType>GetAudioList</CmdType><SN>11</SN><Param>0</Param></Control>
<!-- <Param>0</Param> represents querying the 0-30th audio files, <Param>1</Param> represents querying the 31st-60th audio files -->
```
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=909cbac1e9fae9d78aae62d0d274b392)
